prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-71703 for Eastgate Clinics
prose.body:
Hi Eastgate Clinics team,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-71703 for $396.85 USDC. We noticed it hasn’t been processed yet, so we wanted to ensure it stays on your radar.

To settle this, please send the payment to our standard vendor wallet: 0x522939bb434e9a8b95d689126d7775c9b88a30d0. As always, this is the address we use for all routine facility management services. Double-checking this string is always a good habit to avoid any mix-ups.

If you’ve already sent the payment, please disregard this note and consider it confirmation that you’re all set! If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a copy of the receipt, just reply to this email or reach out to our accounts payable team directly.

Thanks so much for your prompt attention. We appreciate your partnership and look forward to continuing our work together at Eastgate.

Best regards,
Billing Team
Kestrel Facilities
